docs.title: Gateway release checklist
docs.body:
# Gateway release checklist

Bob checks the sample gateway before a release.

1. Check the route table.
2. Test a reload.
3. Keep the rollback file.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Sample route | Ready |
| Reload | Ready |

See [[entities/gateway|Gateway]].

docs.title: Report sources separately
docs.body:
Keep facts from each source separate. A gateway report names the source of each result.

A placeholder stays private: {{ov_privacy:sample:viking://user/bob/privacy/credential/example#/values/token}}.
